input_selection: Use the image-supported overlay fixed before structure statistics. No choice among transcriptions by statistical score.
scope: One 256-byte stream, original 32 rows of 8 cells across LP2-49/50/51. Diagnostic only, no decryption search.
hypothesis: The source-aligned byte sequence departs from independent uniform bytes under one of four prespecified statistics.
statistics: abs(2 * unordered equal-byte pairs - 255), a two-sided collision statistic
abs(256 * adjacent equal-byte count - 255), a two-sided adjacency statistic
max over 8 bit positions of abs(2 * one-count - 256)
sum over 8 source-aligned columns of (8 * column byte-sum - total byte-sum)^2
null_model: 9999 independent uniform 256-byte draws via Python Random(seed).randbytes(256), every draw evaluated on all four statistics. This null does not preserve the observed histogram.
p_value: (1 + null statistic >= observed count) / 10000; Bonferroni factor 4 across the prespecified statistics. Bit-plane maximum already recomputed in every null draw.
positive_controls: Constant zero bytes for severe collision, adjacency and bit bias; repeated columns 0,32,...,224 for column separation. Controls evaluated by the same null samples; no plaintext recovery control applicable.
limits: Failure to reject is not evidence of encryption or randomness. Rejection is not a decryption. No unknown-key search, file-type inference, statistical novelty claim or cryptographic authentication.
memory: Streaming samples, one 256-byte draw at a time; fixed 256-entry count arrays, no ensemble retention.
